verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks, which are HTTP notifications sent automatically to your server after a call completes, so the after-call delivery half of the story is covered. Nothing in the pack shows configurable structured extraction of outcomes, entities or dispositions; Evals grade calls with LLM judges, but that is a separate quality-scoring feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented structured-data extraction schema, entity and disposition fields in webhook or API payloads, an API endpoint to retrieve extracted data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Post-call webhooks are HTTP notifications that Bland AI automatically sends to your server after a phone call completes.
